item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: “60s-70s” Danish package-holiday pig feast: cochinillo asado, crispy roast suckling pig with patatas panaderas (oven-baked potatoes with olive oil, vegetables, white wine and stock) and beer sauce, topped with parsley. Served with ensalada verde of chicory, iceberg, tomatoes and spring onion tossed in olive oil, lemon juice and salt. (6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Paella de marisco, classic Spanish paella with mussels, prawns and squid cooked with Spanish bomba rice and saffron fish stock, topped with parsley. Served with lemon, aioli and a fennel and orange salad with manzanilla olives tossed in olive oil and sherry vinegar. The dish is gluten free. (2+3+5+13+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Paella de verduras, classic Spanish paella with seasonal vegetables cooked with Spanish bomba rice and saffron vegetable stock, topped with parsley. Served with lemon, aioli and a fennel and orange salad with manzanilla olives tossed in olive oil and sherry vinegar. The dish is gluten free. (2+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Slow-roasted pork in red coconut curry with plenty of fresh vegetables, medium hot, served with rice. (7+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Red curry, medium hot, with chickpeas and plenty of fresh vegetables, served with rice. (7+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chicken in autumn curry, a curry sauce of warm spices with pumpkin, apple and plenty of other delicious vegetables, served with rice. (13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu in autumn curry, a curry sauce of warm spices with pumpkin and plenty of other delicious vegetables, served with rice. (7+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Danish pork tenderloin casserole, tender pieces of pork tenderloin baked in a traditional, rich cream sauce with mushrooms, vegetables and bacon, served on pasta and topped with parsley. Served with steamed Brussels sprouts and peas tossed in butter-flavoured oil. (1+6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Danish soy protein casserole, pieces of soy protein baked in a traditional, rich cream sauce with mushrooms, vegetables and smoked tofu, served on pasta and topped with parsley. Served with steamed Brussels sprouts and peas tossed in butter-flavoured oil. (1+6+7+15)
